<teammate-message teammate_id="fix-3004-codegen-facade" color="blue" summary="PR #3011 merged, fixes #3004">
Done. PR #3011 "fix(codegen): make concept-reads facade module path configurable (#3004)" — all 15 CI checks green, squash-merged to master (merge commit 7eec4561e641311a309d7f79979355dff29c8e24).

One flag before the summary: the workdir I was launched in (/Users/pablofernandez/Work/nostr-multi-platform) was actually the main checkout on branch `master`, not an isolated worktree — it had diverged from origin and carried unrelated uncommitted changes from other work. I didn't touch it; instead I created my own worktree at /Users/pablofernandez/Work/nmp-worktrees/3004-facade-module-path off origin/master, did the work there, and removed it + the local branch after the PR merged. Just flagging in case the launcher's worktree provisioning has a bug worth checking.

What changed (all in crates/nmp-codegen/src/concept_reads/):
- app_registry_format.rs: added `rust_module: String` to `FacadeRow` with `#[serde(default = "default_rust_module")]` returning `"facade"`.
- app_registry.rs: added `rust_module` to `ConceptReadFacade`, a new `validate_module_path` validator (accepts `::`-separated lower_ident segments, so nested module paths work too), and threaded the field through construction.
- rust.rs: `render_imports` now emits `use crate::{registry.facade.rust_module}::{rust_type};` instead of the hardcoded `crate::facade::`.
- app_registry_tests.rs: added a locked-in assertion that the existing fixture (no `rust_module` field) still renders `use crate::facade::GalleryApp;` (proves the default), plus two new tests — custom module renders correctly, and an invalid module value (e.g. `"App"`, uppercase) is rejected.

Verification done:
- `cargo test -p nmp-codegen` — 157 passed
- `cargo test -p nmp-testing --test doctrine_lint_smoke` — 210 passed
- `cargo run -p nmp-codegen -- gen concept-reads --registry apps/nmp-gallery/concept-reads.json --platform rust --check` — drift check still passes unchanged (confirms the default didn't perturb the real gallery golden file)
- `cargo fmt -p nmp-codegen -- --check` — clean

No golden/snapshot regen was needed since nmp-app-gallery's registry doesn't declare `rust_module` and resolves to the same default. Chirp itself is untouched (external repo, out of scope per the task). [...] Assistant: #3004 → Done (PR #3011 merged, issue auto-closed).
